ns2:section.sectionText: A weekend field trip to Dixon Springs in southern Illinois for ESE majors and professors that investigates the environment of Southern Illinois, examining the ecology, geology and sustainability of the region. Activities will include a writing workshop, a tour of Midwestern forests and wetlands, nature photography, and a geological hike. The trip occurs Oct 9th - 11th. Grading will be S/U. The School is subsidizing the travel costs. There is a field trip fee of $140.
ns2:section.sectionNotes: Restricted to Earth Systems, Env, & Society or Earth, Society, & Environment or Earth, Soc, Env Sustainability major(s).
